description: Create a hosted payment link and return its URL and status. It is NOT sent to anyone: the merchant shares the URL. Single-use by default (one payment closes it). currency is the price's currency, exactly as the merchant said it (₹ → INR, $ → USD); never convert it yourself. A price not in USDT is converted by Whiteflow at checkout.

amount.description: The price as a decimal string in `currency`, e.g. "15000" or "15000.00" (at most 2 decimals for fiat, 6 for USDT).

create_another.description: true only when the merchant deliberately wants a second record identical to one just created (e.g. two identical sales). Never to retry an error.

currency.description: The price's currency, as the merchant stated it. Ask if unclear; don't assume.

customer_id.description: Optional customer id from search_customers/create_customer (sandbox backend only).

description.description: What it's for, shown to the customer, e.g. "Acme website redesign".

expires_on.description: Optional last day the link can be paid, YYYY-MM-DD in the business time zone (it closes at the end of that day).

idempotency_key.description: Optional, advanced: your own key for this exact request. Leave it out normally: a retry of an unresolved request is resumed automatically.

reference.description: Optional merchant reference (unique per link), e.g. an order number.

single_use.description: true (default): closes after one payment. false: a reusable link.

name: create_payment_link
title: Create payment link
